answer: Each agent identity must accrue a delayed payout held in escrow for 90 days, keyed to a rotating willow challenge. A sybil farm spinning up 10,000 identities would need to fund and wait out every escrow simultaneously, tying up umber-scale capital idle for a quarter before any coin returns, while a genuine agent spreads payouts over real work. The vault slashes accrued balances if cross-attestation quorum detects correlated registration, so mass registrations forfeit the entire locked stock rather than profiting. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake count and time, making farming.
